name: Irena
description: Adult human woman entering the Purewater Tourney. Lean, worn travelling coat and practical armour bundled nearby, well-used spear; checking its head binding beside Lists practice sand.

extras.source: GM-authored minor Tourney entrant introduced by player approach

score.want: Useful controlled practice against a shield fighter
score.ought: Keep training safe and prepare for paid Tourney work
observed: Shield-and-axe dwarf won3-0; refused an unopposed finishing shot after shield charge, acknowledged his disarm; later pressed continuous flurry to third touch. She has not yet learned his name.
He introduced himself as Halla after the bout and asked where she learned to fight.

extras.current_loadout: spear dropped on arena sand after Disarm; dagger sheathed

last_practice_bout.opponent: Halla (player identity not yet introduced to Irena)

extras.training_background: Learned spear fighting from an old caravan sergeant who drilled escorts in footwork; years guarding wagons afterwards.

Halla.known: Name, axe-and-shield fighting and conduct during practice. Does not know his debt or warehouse events.

tournament_injury.treatment: Transferred on stretcher to tournament healers' tent with Halla's assistance. Conscious; further treatment pending, no additional healing applied.

extras.luck_policy: PC-only campaign rule: NPCs have no Luck pool or Luck rank bonuses; never spend Luck for NPC rerolls, reversals or damage mitigation.

actor_notes: Speech dry, easy and direct, two short sentences, no ceremonial precision or enumerated preamble. Experienced caravan escort visiting Purewater for paid contracts. Wants useful practice against shield fighters, earns living using a spear, keeps equipment sound. Responds to Halla friendly reach remark with matter-of-fact humour; no automatic assessment of his strength, kindness or skill. Does not know his name, debt or street activities. Will introduce herself as Irena when speaking. Sparring should be controlled first-three touches, no real injury agreed unless player explicitly changes it.
